data.sql: UPDATE players SET alignment = 500 WHERE name = 'good_trader';
UPDATE players SET alignment = -500 WHERE name = 'evil_trader';

tests.name: Rig: Locate a port with illegal commodity rows

data.sql: SELECT p.port_id, p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN port_trade pt ON pt.port_id = p.port_id WHERE pt.commodity IN ('SLV','WPN','DRG') GROUP BY p.port_id, p.sector_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pt.commodity) = 3 ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Rig: Move good_trader to the selected port sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{illegal_sector_id} WHERE name = 'good_trader';

tests.name: Rig: Move good_trader ship to the selected port sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{illegal_sector_id} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'good_trader');

tests.name: Rig: Move evil_trader to the selected port sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = @{illegal_sector_id} WHERE name = 'evil_trader';

tests.name: Rig: Move evil_trader ship to the selected port sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = @{illegal_sector_id} WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'evil_trader');
